subject: POC timeline & milestones - Globex Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@globex.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@globex.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan and timeline

Hi Elena / Samir - thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before a formal SOW:

Summary of needs (from our discussion)
- Integrate Redwood inference for semantic search and chat on a subset of Globex product docs and support transcripts
- SLOs: sub-200ms median token latency for retrieval-augmented generation in test env; inference cost targets to fit within pilot budget
- Data: Globex will provide de-identified support transcripts + product docs (approx 40k docs)

Proposed POC objective (success criteria)
1) Accuracy: retrieval + RAG answers achieve >= 80% precision on our core FAQ evaluation set (we'll provide the rubric)
2) Latency: median token latency < 200ms for 95% of requests in the pilot test load
3) Operational: Redwood SDK integrated in staging, with automated KV/prefix cache enabled and weekly load > 1k queries/day

High-level timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (kickoff): Apr 5 - goals, access, owners, test dataset delivery
- Week 1: initial integration and baseline runs (setup + smoke tests)
- Week 2: tuning (batching/quantization/caching), weekly check-in #1
- Week 3: evaluation runs, final tuning, weekly check-in #2
- Week 4: readout and decision (final readout meeting)

Roles / ownership
- Globex: Elena (POC owner, data delivery), Samir (app owner), Raj (security/procurement)
- Redwood: Marissa (AM/PM), Vivek (Solutions Eng - infra + access), David (Customer Success - adoption)

Attachments: draft POC plan attached (20270328-draft-poc-plan.pdf).

Next steps: please confirm the success criteria above and whether Apr 5 (10:00 PT) works for the kickoff. Also flag any mandatory security questionnaires or procurement steps we should loop in now.

Thanks - Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan and timeline

Hi Marissa - this looks good, thanks for the thorough recap. A few quick clarifications so we can align on the procurement side:

1) Timeline: Apr 5 kickoff looks OK for us, but Raj wants the detailed milestone dates in a shared spreadsheet so procurement can map approvals. Can you share the updated timeline as an XLSX?
2) Security: we will need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II and details on data handling for the staging environment. Is VPC peering or private endpoint supported for the trial?
3) Success criteria: the accuracy and latency targets look reasonable. We will add a business acceptance metric related to answer helpfulness (qualitative) - we'll share sample evaluation prompts next week.

Samir: looping you in to confirm app-owner readiness to allocate a dev for the integration next week.

Thanks - Elena

Thanks Elena - attached is an updated POC plan with explicit dates and deliverables (20270330-poc-plan-updated.xlsx). Answers to your questions below:

- Procurement / timeline: XLSX includes milestone dates for sign-offs. High-level: kickoff Apr 5, baseline integration complete by Apr 12, tuning complete by Apr 19, readout Apr 26. If procurement needs extra time to sign SOW, we can start the technical onboarding while the legal review runs.
- Security: Redwood supports private endpoints for Dedicated and VPC peering options for Private deployments. For the hosted POC we can provide an isolated staging tenant, encrypted at-rest, and IP allowlisting for API keys. SOC 2 Type II report: https://redwood.example.com/soc2-report. If you prefer, Vivek can join to review security architecture.
- Evaluation prompts: appreciated - we can load your sample prompts into a test harness and include them in the readout scoring.

Proposed kickoff invite: Apr 5, 10:00 PT - calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=POC_kickoff_20270405_1000PT

If that works, I'll send the calendar invite + short agenda.

Best - Marissa

Date: 2027-04-01T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Technical prep & checklist for POC kickoff (Apr 5)

Hi Elena / team - quick technical checklist so the kickoff can be productive:

1) Access
- Please create a staging service account for testing and share a public SSH key for secure artifact transfer.
- Provide a sample of the de-identified support transcripts (500-1,000 rows) and a subset of product docs (10-20) as S3 links or secure upload.

2) Network / Security
- For the hosted staging tenant we'll need an IP allowlist (public IPs) or we can stand up a private endpoint - let us know preference. If Globex needs VPC peering we'll need network contact to coordinate.

3) Test harness & prompts
- Send the evaluation prompts in a CSV (prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_answer) so we can run automated scoring.

4) Weekly check-ins
- Propose Tuesdays 9:00 PT - 30m standups (Apr 12, Apr 19). I'll include a short agenda: blockers, tuning actions, next deliverables.

5) Deliverables before readout
- Baseline runs and latency report
- Quality eval report vs your rubric
- Recommendations (batching, quantization, caching config) and cost estimate for scale

If you can confirm access method and share the sample dataset by end of day Apr 2, we can hit the baseline integration target on Apr 12.

Thanks - Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
